description: Locale-independent clinical-rule invariants. Every rule statement listed here must be asserted by all five locale drafts of the referenced routes, so a rule fix can never land in a subset of locales again. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions matched against the raw draft markdown.

invariants.description: White space S attaches to a basic location (WS, DS, DdS) and is never a complete stand-alone response location. RIAP v5 sequences print WS/DS/DdS only.

en: not a stand-alone basic location code
pt: não é um código básico independente

invariants.description: Bare M / FM / m are Structural Summary family labels. An individual response requires the active/passive suffix (Xa, Xp, Xa-p).

en: is not a complete response code
ja: 完全な入力コードとして使用しません

invariants.description: One movement code per family per response. Active and passive codes from the same family are never entered as separate determinants.

es: no se introducen en casillas separadas
pt: não são inseridos em campos separados

invariants.description: When separate objects in one family show active and passive movement, the a-p code is entered once. One object showing both is not automatically a-p.

es: una vez, en lugar de introducir
pt: uma vez, em vez de inserir

invariants.description: A blank FQ field is unfinished input, not the FQnone category. FQnone must be selected explicitly.
Each distinct content code is recorded at most once within one response.

ko: 같은 내용 부호는 한 번만 기록한다
en: Each content code is recorded only once within a response
ja: 同じ内容コードを一度だけ記録します
es: Cada código de contenido se registra una sola vez dentro de una respuesta
pt: Cada código de conteúdo é registrado apenas uma vez em cada resposta

invariants.description: Na takes priority over Bt and Ls. Without Na, only one of Bt or Ls is recorded within a response.
When Xy is recorded for a response, An is not added as a secondary content code.

ja: `Xy`.*`An`.*(?:併記しません|加えません|ではなく)

invariants.description: Only one form-emphasis category is recorded for the same determinant in one response. Distinct shading kinds may coexist when supported by distinct wording.

en: Do not record more than one form-emphasis category
ja: 同じ決定因について形態の関与度
形態の関与が最も少ない
es: No registre más de una categoría de predominio formal
pt: Não registre mais de uma categoria de predomínio formal

invariants.description: Pure achromatic C-prime has no form and therefore uses the explicit FQnone category.
DV, DR, INCOM, and FABCOM Level 1/2 pairs are alternatives within one response. When the level is uncertain, Level 1 is used conservatively.

en: only one level from each pair
ja: 各組のどちらか一方だけ
es: un solo nivel de cada par
pt: apenas um nível de cada par

invariants.description: Different critical Special Scores may coexist only for discrete wording. Overlapping wording receives only the higher WSum6-weighted score.
A response scored CONTAM does not also receive DV, DR, INCOM, FABCOM, or ALOG.
Color Projection CP is not combined with FC, CF, or C for the same achromatic color projection.
The Lower Section Interpersonal overview includes GHR:PHR as a descriptive frequency ratio and does not treat it as a stand-alone conclusion.

ja: この比率だけで.*断定しません
es: Por sí sola no permite concluir

invariants.description: S-CON is positive when at least 8 of its 12 criteria are met. Every locale must state the complete calculation boundary.
